clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Water is a quest centered in Westfall that tasks adventurers with purifying corrupted elemental forces. By unraveling restless spirits with radiant light, players commune with a Minor Manifestation of Water to safeguard the region's dwindling vitality.

In the windswept lands of Westfall, the natural balance of the waters faces contamination by corrupt spirits. The rite known as the Call of Water requires confronting this malevolence, invoking sacred words that conjure radiant light to disperse the restless, tainted essences into harmless ash and quiet mist.

With the corrupt entities driven back, a Minor Manifestation of Water can safely emerge to commune. While the immediate corruption ebbs, the spirit cautions that the vital energies of the land continue to wane, reminding champions that preserving life is an unending vigil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks to you. Thanks to the adventurers.
Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to adventurers to protect life.
